content: Firebase Security Rules and Authentication: request.auth is null when the caller is not signed in, so rules cannot distinguish one user from another without Firebase Auth. Per-user authorization requires auth.uid, custom claims (request.auth.token), or a get() lookup into a role document. Anonymous Auth gives each device a stable uid and sign_in_provider == 'anonymous', which is the minimum viable way to get per-user Firestore rules without any login UI.
